column1: # content: the gap of the hidden-axis pair at the Fermi surface along the deflation clock
column2: with contact couplings and the exchange of the Vorton-Scalar; g_VS = exp(tau_d/2)
column3: fermion mass m = 1; contact couplings proportional to g_VS^2 (all couplings of the reduced Lagrangian grow as exp(tau_d))
column4: with the range parameter m_ct = m (each contact coupling g is replaced by g m_ct^2/(q^2 + m_ct^2)). Variants: 0 = exchange of the Vorton-Scalar alone (as before); 1 = exchange and scalar contact attraction
column5: g_0eff = -g^2/m^2; 2 = exchange and contact couplings in the ratio of the author's example
column7: g_1eff = +0.1 g^2/m^2; 3 = exchange and vector contact repulsion alone
column8: g_1eff = +0.3 g^2/m^2; 4 = exchange and axial contact coupling
column9: g_7eff = -0.1 g^2/m^2; 5 = contact couplings alone (no Vorton-Scalar)
column11: g_1eff = +0.1 g^2/m^2; 6 = exchange alone with a phase mode of mass 0.3 m (explicitly broken symmetry)

column10: in units of m; variant; m_s; k_F; tau_d; g = g_VS; lambda = N(0) W(k_F
column11: k_F): dimensionless pairing strength; gap: gap at the Fermi surface in units of the Fermi kinetic energy E_F (0: below 1e-7 E_F or no solution); Tc_over_gap (computed for the variants 0
column12: 2 and 5 where the kernel has no sign change; NaN otherwise)
